x_938076_backup_0_backup_scripts.description: Update the system property glide.ui.html.editor.extended_valid_elements to ensure that custom elements and attributes are preserved in the TinyMCE editor. Specifically, it appends "now-illustration-custom[token-id|src|alt|width|height]" to the existing property value, allowing the now-illustration-custom element with the specified attributes to be retained when the editor saves content
x_938076_backup_0_backup_scripts.name: Update Valid Elements for TinyMCE
